label: bug
file: src/export/csv.ts

The issue describes a bug where transactions with the same date, amount, and description but different currencies are being merged in the CSV export. This suggests the CSV writer is not accounting for currency differences when writing rows, which should be preserved as distinct entries.

input.title: Prevent merging of transactions with same date, amount, and description but different currencies
input.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The CSV writer currently merges transactions that share the same date, amount, and description, causing transactions with different currencies to be lost in the export. This happens because the logic does not account for the currency field when distinguishing between transactions. The fix should ensure that transactions are treated as distinct if their currency differs, even if other fields match.

File: src/export/csv.ts

The CSV writer currently merges transactions that share the same date, amount, and description, causing transactions with different currencies to be lost in the export. The fix should ensure that transactions are treated as distinct if their currency differs, even if other fields match.
